descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S18 A double-tapped add in Nursing Home on the phone: one resident, in the right context, on the computer

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 A patient added on the phone appears on the computer in real time, with no refresh or re-entry. (UAT TC-25 step 2; UAT TC-25; TFA-94704 AC 5; TFA-94513 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital. (UAT TC-25 step 6; UAT TC-25; UAT 3.3) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Phone on the Nursing Home add form; computer on the Hospital list

When The phone fills 'QA Sync Resident 2' and double-taps 'Add to Resident Panel' (locator.dblclick, or two click() calls with no await between); the computer then switches to Nursing Home

Then The computer's Hospital list never shows the resident; its Nursing Home list shows exactly one 'QA Sync Resident 2'

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Scripted: the computer's Hospital list (no reload) never shows 'QA Sync Resident 2'; its Nursing Home list shows 'QA Sync Resident 2' exactly once (count = 1); neither page shows 'Sign-in code' or 'Something went wrong'. Whether the duplicate confirm (findSnfMatch -> window.confirm) appeared is recorded from page.on('dialog'): a confirm means the second tap reached the add, an …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S18 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-25.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-25/S18

A double-tapped add in Nursing Home on the phone: one resident, in the right context, on the computer

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress); TFA-94704 Production Web App Hosting + PWA (development backlog)

New local lane probes: status passed in probes/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): sync-probe: phone NH add form, 'Add to Resident Panel' double-clicked (dialogs recorded and dismissed); computer Hospital list (no reload) never shows the resident; its NH All Residents shows exactly one; backend count 1. — Scripted dblclick; an LLM agent cannot double-tap.

Detail:

Double-tapped 'Add to Resident Panel' on the phone: the computer's Hospital list never showed the resident; its All Residents shows it exactly once; one row stored; no duplicate confirm appeared.

Evidence: 2 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — sync-probe (scripted, not written yet): two contexts with their own createAuthSession sessions (local admin key), a scripted double tap and a dialog listener; on dev the runner never signs in and has no admin key, so as designed it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
